diagnosis.summary: All 58 blank cards in 14 sections across 9 pages are a single exporter defect, not intentionally-empty content. Every one of the 14 source exports has full content in src/data.
diagnosis.root_cause: The 0.10.1 exporter that produced these pages read list items through a fixed key vocabulary — title|label|name|term|q|question for the card title and detail|body|summary|description|a|answer|definition for the card body (the same vocabulary that survives in wordpress/scripts/port-content-044.mjs as titleOf()/bodyOf()). The two integration item shapes in src/data use neither set: {product, need, path} for product-boundary tables and {role, flow} for use-case grids. Both resolved to the empty string. The link was lost the same way: the exporter read i.href, while these items carry i.path.
diagnosis.why_it_was_silent: The exporter mapped items 1:1 with no `.filter(c => c.title || c.body)`, so the card arrays kept the exact source item counts (5,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,5,4,4,4 = 58). Nothing looked missing in the manifest; the loss only appears at render time.
diagnosis.exporter_status: ABSENT from this repo. wordpress/scripts/port-content-044.mjs is the only script that writes content-pages.json, and it merges by slug with an explicit `SKIP <slug> — already in the manifest, not overwriting`. These 9 pages came with the Core 0.10.1 base, so the code that emptied them is not in the tree. The vocabulary defect is reproduced (and partly mitigated) in port-content-044.mjs: it added a filter that would DROP such cards instead of emitting hollow ones, but neither product/need nor role/flow is in its LIST vocabulary either, so it would silently lose them too if it ever ran on these pages.
diagnosis.render_effect: class-content-pages.php::card() returns '' when title and body are both empty; section() then returns '' for a cards section whose cards all render empty AND whose lead is empty. All 14 sections have lead: "". So all 14 sections vanish from the HTML.
diagnosis.pages_affected: 5 pages lose 2 sections each (freshdesk, salesforce, zendesk, zoho-crm, tong-dai-quoc-te) and 4 pages lose 1 section each (hubspot, tong-dai-tich-hop-crm, tong-dai-tich-hop-helpdesk, tong-dai-tich-hop-pos) — 14 sections total, not 10.

merge_instructions: For each entry, locate the section in content-pages.json by page_slug + section_from (section_index given as a cross-check) and replace it wholesale with `after`. `before` is included so a merge can assert it is patching the section it thinks it is. Card key `current` is informational — the PHP renderer ignores unknown keys.
